questions.prompt: You share a Claude chat, then send five more messages. What do the people you invited see?

options.text: Every message, including the five new ones
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center says sharing creates a snapshot. New messages show only if you update the shared chat.

options.text: The chat up to the moment you shared it
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: sharing creates a snapshot of the chat at the moment you share it.
They see the snapshot from when you shared, not only the newer messages.

questions.prompt: A Claude Team member is removed. Their private project had no other members. What happens to it?

options.text: It moves to an Owner automatically
options.explanation: That is OpenAI's rule for ChatGPT. The Claude Help Center says other members can't access a private project after removal.

options.text: It becomes public to the whole team
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center says the opposite: a private project stays closed to other members.

options.text: Other members can no longer open it
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: other members can't access a private project once its member is removed. Share it with Can edit first.

questions.prompt: Someone shares a Gemini chat as a link. Who can read it?

options.explanation: Right. Google: anyone with the link can read the chat, even if you didn't share it with them directly.
The Gemini Apps Help says the link is public. Anyone with it can read and reshare the chat.

options.text: Only people in the same company
options.explanation: That is Claude's rule on Team and Enterprise plans. Google's share link is public.
